product.title: ONEWISH Industrial Table Lamp for Bedroom, Fully Dimmable Modern Bedside Lamps with 2700K Warm Light Bulb for Kids Reading, Minimalist Nightstand Lamps for Living Room, Office (Bulb Included)

reviews.reviewDescription: Hope this helps! This lamp creates the perfect ambience for any room, and I especially love the dimming feature—it works really smoothly and gives great control over the lighting. At the lowest setting, it’s perfect for recording videos and provides beautiful ambient light without being harsh. The bulb is unique in how it directs light, and I wish I could find more bulbs like this one because of its special effect. It has great build, not too large, and feels high quality and sturdy. No usb port. Plug is shorter than i'd like. Although I spent more than I initially wanted, the quality and effectiveness have made it well worth the investment.
reviews.author: AEBK7XXY4IU233A3BCQVXGXPZMVQ

reviews.reviewDescription: This is a great lamp for a tabletop, stylish, includes a bulb (which is also very stylish), and the dimming function is nice to have as well. I’ve plugged mine into a smart plug so it’s incredibly easy to use via Alexa or the plug’s schedule. Seems very well-built and sits perfectly flat on my table with no unwanted rocking or moving (I’ve had other cheaper lamps that don’t sit flat and wobble).
reviews.author: AFM73YEDKJK3AQBYO3DGBSPBWP4A

reviews.reviewTitle: Nice lamp to set off your office
reviews.reviewDescription: Excellent lamp for an office setup. Comes with a nice bulb and it has a dial to adjust the brightness. Looks great on my desk.

reviews.reviewDescription: Love the aesthetic of this light. But the bulb is UNCOMFORTABLY bright. I bought it for my desk but had to move it to my nightstand because the light was so bright in my face. Even on my nightstand though, it’s still uncomfortable. Even at the lowest dim setting.
